entities.summary: Joanna Truffaut is a French entrepreneur and advisor known for her work in digital transformation, smart cities and luxury real estate. She initially gained recognition for developing public Wi-Fi networks in the United States and France and later founded several technology ventures in the Middle East. Truffaut is now the Founder and Managing Partner of Bond Properties Global, a Dubai and Abu Dhabi-based real estate brokerage specializing in prime and ultra-prime properties for high-net-worth investors. Truffaut is an alumna of Institut Mines-Télécom and of Virginia Tech.
